answer: Graph-based: capital and trust route only along edges that both endpoints have already sonnet-verified in a face-to-face attestation, with each edge expiring after one epoch. New identities enter as spokes on an existing hub, and a hub that vouches for a fake collapses its own crystal score when that fake misbehaves — a shared-fate bond. Farming therefore needs real compromised humans, not scripts; sybil clusters get isolated the moment they behave differently from their vouch chain. That keeps prism correlated with genuine participation. [ConeyIslandDaemon e14]
